subject: Issue with Including R File in server.R

messages.author: 10c8cda73c65d9b2
messages.subject: Issue with Including R File in server.R
parts:
I am using a source('plotcode.r', local=TRUE) command to include my code for plotting in server.R in a for loop:

            for (i in 1:iterations)
            {
                source('plotcode.r', local=TRUE)
            } 

For some reason, the code always crashes whenever it gets to an else condition and gives an error on code such as:

                if (input$multBy==""){
                    barElements <- 2
                }
                else{


Error in source("plotcode.r", local = TRUE) : 
  plotcode.r:26:17: unexpected 'else'
25:                 }
26:                 else

However, when I remove the else conditions and change them to "if" conditions, it works.  However, this change is not even necessary when I have the exact same code in server.R. Has anyone ever come across this problem?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Issue with Including R File in server.R
parts:
You should always avoid putting `else` on its own line (even though it
works *sometimes*), as the documentation tells you: ?`else`

if (foo) {
}
else {
}

is bad, and

if (foo) {
} else {
}

is good.

Regards,
Yihui
